The '''1971 census of India''' was the 11th in a series of [[census of India|censuses]] held in [[India]] every decade since [[Census of India prior to independence|1872]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Vijayanunni, M.|date=26–29 August 1998|title=Planning for the 2001 Census of India based on the 1991 Census|url=http://www.ancsdaap.org/cencon98/papers/india/india.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081119080707/http://www.ancsdaap.org/cencon98/papers/india/india.pdf|archive-date=19 November 2008|access-date=25 March 2021|website=18th Population Census Conference|publisher=Association of National Census and Statistics Directors of America, Asia, and the Pacific|location=Honolulu, Hawaii, US}}</ref>

The population of India was counted as 547,949,809 people.<ref name="census1971">{{cite web |url=http://lsi.gov.in:8081/jspui/bitstream/123456789/362/1/24695_1971_GRO.pdf |title=Intercensal Growth of Population |date=29 March 1972 |author=D. Natarajan |access-date= 4 May 2021 |url-status=live |archive-date=4 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210504050253/http://lsi.gov.in:8081/jspui/bitstream/123456789/362/1/24695_1971_GRO.pdf}}</ref>
